agentLoop.label: Inside Snowflake
agentLoop.role: Reason over governed data, then act
items: Cortex Agents + AISQL, next to the data
Semantic Views: one shared definition of every metric
Cortex Analyst + Search for cited answers
AI Agent Identity: per-agent access, full lineage
loop: A rep asks a Cortex Agent in Snowflake Intelligence which accounts are at risk.
The agent calls Semantic Views and Cortex Search, and answers with citations.
The agent drafts the outreach and posts it back to the CRM through a governed endpoint.
The whole exchange is logged against one identity and lineage.
